page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-8-lssd is a general-purpose virtual machine offering balanced compute and integrated high-speed local NVMe storage. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 9B45 processor based on x86_64 architecture, delivering 8 vCPUs across 4 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The CPU configuration provides 48 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache, complemented by support for advanced vector extensions including AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, and AVX-512 BF16. System memory is sized at 31.0 GB, which yields roughly 3.88 GB per vCPU.

Storage consists of a bundled 402 GB local NVMe SSD, providing high-throughput local scratch space without relying solely on network-attached block storage. The instance does not include a dedicated GPU accelerator, nor does it come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results highlight strong single-threaded performance. The AMD EPYC 9B45 achieved top-tier rankings in stress-ng single-core execution (3462.79) and Geekbench single-core testing (2584.0), alongside top-tier throughput in gzip compression (38.01 GB/sec) and bzip3 single-threaded decompression (16.92 GB/sec). Text generation on small 135M language models also registered in the top 10% at 347.94 tokens per second. In contrast, multi-core benchmarks placed in the middle tier, including a Geekbench multi-core score of 10053.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 17657.87. Prompt processing on medium 7B parameter models showed weaker performance, reaching only 30.58 tokens per second.

The qualitative cost-efficiency profile of the c4d-standard-8-lssd is shaped by the inclusion of dedicated local NVMe storage alongside top-tier per-core compute performance. It provides solid value for architectures that require fast single-thread throughput combined with low-latency local disk I/O, though users running heavily parallelized compute or large language models will encounter standard mid-range scaling limits. Best-fit workloads include transactional databases, high-performance web serving, CI/CD compilation pipelines, and caching tiers utilizing local NVMe storage.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-8-lssd is a general-purpose instance featuring 8 vCPUs across 4 dedicated AMD EPYC 9B45 cores, 31.0 GB of RAM, and 402 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD storage. Built on x86_64 architecture with AVX-512 support, the server delivers top-tier single-core CPU throughput, highlighted by high Geekbench single-core marks and rapid compression performance. Multi-core operations, memory bandwidth, and database benchmarks perform consistently in the middle tier. The lack of a GPU limits heavy AI workloads, as evidenced by lower prompt processing rates on 7B parameter models, though small-model token generation remains competitive. With its balanced memory ratio and integrated fast local SSD, the c4d-standard-8-lssd serves as an efficient system for relational databases, web serving, continuous integration builds, and caching layers requiring direct NVMe access.
